name: remoteok
description: RemoteOK (remoteok.com) is a remote job board. This CLI searches and filters remote job listings, reads the public JSON jobs API, opens job details, lists related jobs, company jobs and country jobs, and lists the job tag catalog. No login is needed.

commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Search and filter remote job listings by keyword, tags, location, minimum salary, benefit and company, with sorting

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tag keys from list-tags, e.g. dev,python

params.name: location
params.description: Two-letter country code the job accepts, e.g. US or CA

params.name: min_salary
params.description: Minimum yearly salary in USD, e.g. 100000

params.name: offset
params.description: Result offset for pagination. Leave empty for the first page; the second page is 50.

commands.name: list-jobs-api
commands.summary: List the latest remote jobs as clean JSON from RemoteOK's public API, optionally filtered by one tag (includes salary, location, description and apply URL)

params.name: tag
params.description: Single tag key, e.g. python, dev or marketing

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get the details of one remote job (position, company, location, tags, full description, apply link) by its slug

params.name: slug
params.description: Job slug ending in the job id, as returned by search-jobs or list-jobs-api, e.g. remote-apac-python-kodland-1137534

commands.name: list-related-jobs
commands.summary: List jobs related to a given job (same tag), excluding that job

params.name: except_id
params.description: Numeric id of the job to find related jobs for, e.g. 1137534

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List every job tag key with its display label (use the keys for the tags/tag params)

notes: The first element of the list-jobs-api array is a metadata/legal object (last_updated, legal), not a job. Skip it. The API terms require linking back to the job URL on Remote OK and crediting Remote OK as the source.
Job slugs end with the numeric job id, e.g. remote-apac-python-kodland-1137534 has id 1137534. Use the slug for get-job and the id for list-related-jobs (except_id).
Tag pages also exist at /remote-{tag1}+{tag2}-jobs, e.g. /remote-dev+python-jobs. search-jobs --tags dev,python gives the same results.
search-jobs --location takes a two-letter country code (US, CA). list-country-jobs takes a lowercase country name slug (canada).
Apply links have the form /l/{id} and redirect to the employer's application page.
The RSS feed /remote-jobs.rss is gone (HTTP 410). Use list-jobs-api instead.

The HTML job-row selectors (tr.job with data-id, data-slug, data-url and data-company) come from RemoteOK's jobsboard table markup. The recorded outline only showed the table up to table#jobsboard, so these selectors were not visible in the recording.

dropped.name: list-company-jobs
dropped.summary: List all remote jobs posted by one company, by company slug
dropped.verifyNote: The /company/{slug} page is a JS shell. It ships only tr.placeholder.job rows and loads real jobs through the action=get_jobs infinity-scroll call, so the static HTML never has job data. search-jobs already covers this with its company param.

dropped.summary: List remote jobs open to residents of one country, by country name slug

params.name: country
params.description: Lowercase country name with hyphens for spaces, e.g. canada, united-states, germany

dropped.verifyNote: The /remote-jobs-in-{country} page is the same JS shell, with placeholder rows only and jobs loaded later by JS. search-jobs already covers this with its location param (country code).
